info.title: DataStream Public API
info.description: OData v4 API for querying environmental water quality data.

get.description: Retrieves the dataset-level metadata for the datasets that meet your query criteria.

parameters.name: $select
parameters.description: Fields to return. Defaults to every allowed field.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: OData filter expression, e.g. CharacteristicName eq 'pH' and ActivityStartYear ge '2020'. `lte` and `gte` are accepted as deprecated aliases of `le` and `ge`.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: Return only the count of matching rows (an estimate for large counts).

parameters.name: $skiptoken
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination, e.g. Id:1234. Use the Link header or @odata.nextLink from the previous response.

400.description: Bad request - invalid query (unknown $select/$filter field, malformed expression, or unencoded reserved characters such as $ in parameter names)

408.description: Request timed out (30s) - retry once; if it persists, lower $top and/or add narrower filters

413.description: Response too large - lower $top or $select fewer fields

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit yourself (2 req/s, no parallel requests)

504.description: Request timed out (30s) - retry once; if it persists, lower $top and/or add narrower filters
